title: OWASP Top Ten - Injection
text: Injection flaws, such as SQL injection, occur when untrusted data is sent to an interpreter as part of a command or query. The attacker’s hostile data can trick the interpreter into executing unintended commands or accessing unauthorized data.

title: OWASP Top Ten - XSS
text: Cross-site scripting (XSS) allows attackers to inject client-side scripts into web pages viewed by other users. XSS can be used to bypass access controls such as the same-origin policy.

title: CWE-798 - Use of Hard-coded Credentials
text: The software contains hard-coded credentials, such as passwords or cryptographic keys, which can be easily guessed or exposed. This can lead to unauthorized access to resources.

title: Python AST
text: The ast module helps Python applications to process trees of the Python abstract syntax grammar. It can be used to parse, analyze, and transform Python source code.

title: Esprima JavaScript Parser
text: Esprima is a high performance, standard-compliant ECMAScript parser written in JavaScript. It can be used to generate syntax trees for analysis and transformations.
